title.narrative: Access to Markets Project

description.narrative: Malawi Transport and Land Compact - Accelerated Growth Corridors (AGC) Project - the AGC Project aims to reduce the barriers between farm and market by improving road conditions, encouraging a more transparent and competitive business environment for transporters, and addressing first mile transportation challenges for smallholder farmers. The project will support policy and institutional reforms to enable better road planning and maintenance of AGCs and associated infrastructure, as well as safer conditions for women to move and conduct economic activity along the corridors.

condition.narrative: Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
